t: This is 1890 by Gordon Ramsay, a Michelin-starred French restaurant in London. It belongs to the chef and television presenter Gordon Ramsay. His restaurant group was founded in 1997 and has won seventeen Michelin stars overall, currently holding eight. He rose to fame on the television series Boiling Point in 1999 and has become one of the best-known and most influential chefs in the world.
